notes.title: 0.23.41 Patch Note
notes.content:
All character-specific artifacts now display their character restrictions in the discovery page — great news for achievement hunters!

 When obtaining an artifact that can be used to craft multiple combo artifacts, the game will now prompt you to choose which one to combine.

 Added a cool visual effect for Time Traveler on the character selection screen.

 Added a "Random Character" button to the right side of the character selection screen.

 Expanded support for Workshop updates:

[olist]
 Summon support added! You can now easily create summonable entities for combat (like barrels, pistols, cakes, robots, etc.). Tutorials and examples have been added to our Workshop GitHub repo!

 Multi-stage evolving bullets supported! You can now easily create bullets with multiple evolution stages (like eggs, clocks, etc.). Tutorials and examples are available in our Workshop GitHub repo!

 Added an option to adjust the offset of character portraits on the character selection screen.
[/olist]

notes.title: 0.22.45 Patch Note
notes.content:
Starting this week, the ascension level at which the difficulty of the initial wave stops increasing will depend on the strength of the starting relics. (This week, difficulty scaling for the initial wave will stop at ascension 30.)

 Custom Mode is now available immediately after completing the tutorial.

 The entry point for the Multiplayer Mode has been moved to main menu.

 The ranking rules for the Multiplayer have been optimized. Rankings are now determined solely by wave count and time, regardless of whether the time limit is exceeded. (Exceeding the time limit will still result in a game over.)

notes.title: 0.22.40 Quick Match Update
notes.content:
You can now send preset messages while waiting in a speedrun room!

Winning Rewards Added!
The first-place player in Quick Match will receive a poultry leg as a reward! We've also introduced a poultry leg leaderboard—climb the ranks and show off your victories!

Auto-Start Feature
Quick Match will now auto-start once 5 or more players join the room.

New Opening Hours
To encourage more players to join and play together, Quick Match will only be available during the following hours (subject to adjustments based on player feedback):

07:00–09:00 AM EST
21:00–23:00 PM EST

Jump in and race to the top—see you in Quick Match!

notes.title: Multiplayer Mode is finally here!
notes.content:
Dear Meme Lords,

The long-awaited Multiplayer Racing Mode is finally here!

In this mode, Meme Lords can compete against others to showcase their skills and prove that they’re right and everyone else is wrong. It’s all about real-time fight, and the ultimate fulfilment of proving yourself in front of everyone.

Features of the PVP Mode:

 Custom Seeds: Players will use the same character and identical game settings, based on a shared seed, for a truly even playing field.
 Leaderboards: Rankings are determined by the highest wave reached and the time taken to get there.
 Spectator Mode: If you lose or forfeit, you can watch other players’ strategies to see how they tackle the challenge.


We welcome all Meme Lords to team up, face off, and enjoy some good interactions with friends while testing your skills.

Let the races—and the debates—begin!

notes.title: Future Update Plan!
notes.content:
We’ve recently received a lot of great feedback from our community, and we’re excited to share the adjustments and updates we’re working on for the future!


 Random Card Value Mode in challenge and custom modes.
 More Variety in Weekly Challenges: Look forward to different rules like fixed seeds, Rebel or Debt mode for all characters, banned cards with a full perk pool, and more.
 Perks Matched to Mob Appearance: We’re working on making mob perks more relevant to how they look.
 Mob Reroll Options: We’re adding ways for you to reroll the mob!
 Divine & Legendary Perks Enhancements: We’ll continue polishing these perks for a better experience.
 Senpai’s Poo Buff Duration Improvements
 Ninja’s Steal Time Improvements
 Weekly Leaderboard Trophies: Show off a trophy next to your name if you make it to the leaderboard!
 New Heroes Are Coming: Watch out for fresh faces during the Steam Autumn Sale!


Thank you all for your continued support and feedback—it truly helps us make the game better for everyone!

notes.title: Steam Community Badges, Trading Cards and Emotes!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that we now have Community Badges, Collectable Trading Cards, and Emotes! This is a huge milestone for us, and we couldn’t have done it without YOU, our amazing community. 

Here’s what you can look forward to: 


 Community Badges: Earn cool badges by playing the game!
 Collectable Trading Cards: Collect trading cards, trade them with friends, and complete the set to craft a special badge for your Steam profile!
 Emotes: Express yourself with our fun new emotes!ːbandleader_happyː


We can’t wait for you to enjoy these awesome new features, and as always, thank you for your continued support. 

Let the collecting begin!

❤️ The Meme Mayhem Team

notes.title: Addressing Frequently Asked Questions & Updates
notes.content:
Can you update the demo?

 Our demo was meant to be a small bite of the game to give you a taste of what's to come. However, it’s been over two months since we initially released it, and since then, it has become quite outdated.
 Updating it is extremely hard and time-consuming, especially since we’ve made significant changes, like rewriting the basic logic for waves.
 We'd rather focus our efforts on polishing and adding new content to the main game instead of updating the demo. We hope you understand and continue to look forward to the full experience!


What are we doing during the delay?

 During this delay, we’ve been hard at work on some exciting new content:
 New Characters: We're introducing completely new playable characters to bring more variety and exciting gameplay experiences!
 New Relics and Perks: More ways to customize and enhance your gameplay.
 Modding Support: One of the most requested features is finally coming!


Modding

 We're thrilled to announce that modding support is on its way! We can't wait to see the amazing mods you all come up with.
 To help you get started, we’ve prepared tutorials and examples covering every aspect of modding the game.
 This information will be available right at launch, so you’ll have everything you need to dive in!


Lastly...
We’re still waiting for a response from Valve since July 18th. 

We want to release the game just as much as you do, and we appreciate your patience and understanding as we navigate the Valve review process together.

❤️ The Meme Mayhem Team

notes.title: Important Update: Steam’s Response and What's Ahead
notes.content:
Dear Meme Lords and Ladies,

Hold onto your keyboards... we've got some exciting news! 🎉

After an epic battle of endless emails (and a few too many cookie bribes), we’ve finally gotten Steam to break their silence!  🎊 

While we’re still navigating the labyrinth of Steam’s review process and don’t have a precise release date yet, the great news is that we now have an open line of communication with them! 
This means we're working tirelessly to bring the game to your screens as soon as possible. 

We appreciate your patience and understanding during this rollercoaster ride. Your excitement and support have been nothing short of amazing, and we can’t wait to finally share the full release with you.
Keep those positive vibes and memes coming, and stay tuned for more updates!

With boundless gratitude and excitement,

The Meme Mayhem Team ❤️
